StaticField.name: Static Field
StaticField.tooltip:
Passive: While this ability is available, lightning charges Blitzcrank's fists, marking those Attacked. After 1 second, they are shocked for @PassiveDamage@ magic damage.

Active: Blitzcrank overcharges, dealing @ActiveDamage@ magic damage and Silencing nearby enemies for @SilenceDuration@ seconds. Their shields are also destroyed.
Does not break shields on monsters.

damageRefs.context: Blitzcrank fires their right hand, Pulling the first enemy hit towards them and dealing [{TotalDamage} magic damage] .

RocketGrab.name: Rocket Grab
RocketGrab.tooltip: Blitzcrank fires their right hand, <status>Pulling</status> the first enemy hit towards them and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

Overdrive.name: Overdrive
Overdrive.tooltip:
Blitzcrank supercharges themself, gaining @MoveSpeedMod*100@% decaying Move Speed and @AttackSpeedMod*100@% Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.

Afterwards, Blitzcrank is Slowed by @MoveSpeedModReduction*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
Move Speed decays to @MoveSpeedModMin*100@% over @MoveSpeedModMinTime@ seconds

ManaBarrierIcon.name: Mana Barrier
ManaBarrierIcon.tooltip: When Blitzcrank falls below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, they gain <shield>@ShieldAmount@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
